summary.bn: এক খোলে লাল, সবুজ আর নীল LED; মিশিয়ে যেকোনো রং।
summary.en: A red, a green and a blue LED in one case, for mixing colours.

simplified: The module is taken to have no resistors of its own, so the lab asks for one on each colour. Some versions of the module carry three; adding your own is safe with both.
Forward voltages are one maker's figures (red 1.8 V, green and blue 2.8 V), not measured on the kit's module.
The colour shown mixes the three brightnesses evenly. A real LED's three colours are not equally bright, and they do not blend when you look straight at it.
